settings.hero_text: We build our skincare around plant oils, butters and essential oils. Here are the ones you'll see most often. The full ingredient list for every product is on its product page and on the label.
settings.help_text: If you'd like to check something before you buy, get in touch and we'll point you in the right direction.

settings.heading: Shea butter
settings.text: Rich and creamy. The base of our whipped body butters and salt scrubs.

settings.heading: Cocoa butter
settings.text: Adds a firm, silky melt to our body butters.

settings.heading: Jojoba oil
settings.text: Light and quick to absorb. In our body butters and Lavender Bath Soak.

settings.heading: Sweet almond & avocado oils
settings.text: Softening oils in our facial moisturisers & serums.

settings.heading: Chamomile & calendula
settings.text: Gentle botanicals in our Day Moisturiser, face wash and Lavender & Chamomile Baby Wash.

settings.heading: Sea salt
settings.text: Polishes skin in our salt scrubs.

settings.heading: Essential oils
settings.text: Lavender, grapefruit, geranium, sweet orange, lemon and cedarwood scent our skincare.

settings.heading: Witch hazel
settings.text: The refreshing base of our Facial Toner Mist.

settings.heading: About allergens
settings.text: Essential oils naturally contain fragrance allergens such as linalool and limonene. These are marked with * in every ingredient list so you can check before you buy.

settings.heading: Fragrance oils
settings.text: Our Black Cherry Body Butter and our home fragrance range (candles, room sprays, diffusers, car blends) use fragrance oils, listed as Parfum where they apply to skin.

settings.heading: Patch test
settings.text: Everyone's skin is different. Try a small amount on your inner arm first and stop using any product if irritation occurs.
